messages:
morgan: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — thanks everyone for the notes. TL;DR: cross-region LB/DNS handoff + aggressive TTLs caused retry amplification during region failover. I opened the postmortem doc: https://redwoodinfranet/internal/postmortems/2026-03-xx-dns-egress-retry

ashley: Saw it. main ask: who owns the TTL change and the synthetic check?

rik: I can take the routing policy changes (failover cooldown + prefer-local). Will need 2d to test canary.

netops: I'll own the DNS side (TTL and registrar coordination). Plan: bump route TTL from 30s -> 120s on edge zones, add documentation, and confirm registrar support. Target: EOD Thu (2026-03-26).

morgan: Thanks. Can you add the exact change and rollback plan in the doc so we can approve?

netops: Will do. Adding snippet to postmortem:
```
# proposed change
record: api.redwood.net
old_ttl: 30
new_ttl: 120
notes: increase to reduce query amplification during cross-region switchover
```

ashley: Also need a synthetic that hits both regions and measures retry spike. @sre-oncall can you add it to the SLO checks?

sre-oncall: Yep — I'll add a dual-region probe and a dashboard tile for retries/sec (canary start tomorrow). Putting a tentative owner/label in the doc: probe-slowfail-2026.

morgan: Another action: implement an egress-splay parameter to reduce synchronized failover. Who can run the experiment?

rik: I'll prototype splay at the routing layer. Quick idea: randomize failover delay in 0-6s window per instance. I'll run in staging first. ETA: 48h for prototype, 1 week for gradual rollout with metrics against retry-rate.

devops-bot: deploy-bot: triggered: staging-deploy of routing-splay-prototype PR #487 (rik). status: queued. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

morgan: Perfect. For TLS: we saw a small bump in handshake fails during the retries. Action: auto-retry backoff logic around TLS handshakes to avoid hammering alternative regions.

netops: We should also validate cert chain caching on edge proxies — I'll add that check. If cache misses happen, proxies were re-requesting certs and spiking egress.

ashley: Ownership recap (please confirm):
- DNS TTL + registrar coord -> netops (EOD Thu 2026-03-26)
- Routing failover cooldown + prefer-local -> rik (canary in 2d)
- Synthetic dual-region probe + dashboard -> sre-oncall (start tomorrow)
- TLS handshake backoff improvements -> netops + sre-oncall pair (sync Thu)
- Postmortem doc update + rollback plans -> netops + rik (today)

morgan: Confirmed. Can each owner add a clear PR link + test plan in the postmortem? We want automated gating: no change to prod without probe green and canary metrics show <15% delta in latency/retry.

rik: will add PR links and a short test harness in the doc.

netops: Added registrar ticket #REG-142 and DNS change PR #662 in the doc. Also scheduling a quick ops runbook for emergency rollback.

sre-oncall: After probes are up I'll set an alert: retries/sec > 2x baseline for 5m -> page oncall and mute rollout.

morgan: Awesome. Last item: recurring incident pattern. Ops asked for a weekly review of cross-region retry stats for the next 8 weeks to ensure no recurrence. Can we tag this as "recurrence-watch" and add owners?

ashley: I'll create a recurring calendar invite and add the query to the ops-runbook. Owner: ashley (weekly triage).

morgan: Great. If nobody objects, I'll mark these as Action Items in the postmortem and close the loop once PRs & probes are green. :white_check_mark:

rik: No objections. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

netops: On it.

devops-bot: reminder: staging-deploy PR #487 started at 1718855200, estimated finish 1718855480.

sre-oncall: I'll post the probe metrics link once available.

morgan: Thanks all — please update the doc with timeboxed check-ins (add comments inline).
